title: NASA's fact sheet: surface field about 0.24 to 0.66 gauss, WMM2020 poles
summary: The fact sheet lists a surface field of 0.24 to 0.66 gauss and two different WMM2020 pole positions.
body: NASA's Earth Fact Sheet, under a geomagnetic model labeled WMM2020, lists a surface field strength of 0.24 to 0.66 gauss at one Earth radius, which the sheet defines there as 6,378 kilometers. It lists a geocentric dipole at 80.65 degrees north, 72.68 degrees west, and a magnetic north pole at 86.50 degrees north, 164.04 degrees east. The sheet prints both positions. This card does not treat them as one point. The USGS account of a liquid outer core is a separate statement about a source, not this field table.
